summary: In situ OAM (IOAM) records telemetry data in packets as they travel along a path. This document describes how to carry IOAM data fields inside the Network Service Header (NSH), which is used for service function chaining. It covers the encapsulation only, not new measurements.

eli5.summary: Imagine each stop on a bus route stamps your ticket as you pass. This document says where on the ticket the stamps go when the ticket is a service-chain envelope.

questions: carry telemetry in network service header
